Fresh 2026 reporting shows AI-driven fraud detection/data-matching is now functional in production across at least two separate government systems: SARS's 'Modernisation 3.0' AI cross-checks third-party data (banks, employers, CIPC) and has blocked over R100m in improper outflows (TechCentral, 18 Jun 2026; ITWeb, 2 Apr 2026), while SASSA's verification system cross-references SARS, UIF, GEPF, banks and credit bureaus, cancelling roughly 35,000 fraudulent grants (EWN, 6 Feb 2026). Definition: Current operational status of the data exchange system
Comments: Multiple partial data exchange systems operational: Treasury Secure Data Facility (SDF), SASSA SRD370 system, National Strategic Hub (CoGTA), South African Integrated Data Lake. Whole-of-government real-time data exchange (Initiative 2 of the Digital Transformation Roadmap) is under active development via Inter-Departmental Working Group (IDWG) established September 2024. Full unified exchange hub not yet operational.
